title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1969-02-12

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a transcendent ’69 show highlighted by a soaring Eleven, fiery Alligator Jam and a ripping Caution.
ai_review.review: Fans rave that this recording delivers one of the finest 1969 performances – Garcia is in top form on The Eleven, the brief Alligator Jam bursts with creative fireworks, and a fierce take of Caution rounds out the set. While reviewers don’t comment on audio flaws, the SBD source is assumed clear and well‑balanced, making the musical brilliance fully audible.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviewers gave 5 stars, consistently praising the show’s performance; recording quality is presumed solid from the soundboard source, yielding a near‑perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit audio comments; assumed clear and balanced typical of SBD releases.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Described as a textbook ’69 set with classic flow and high energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is highlighted as being in top form, especially on The Eleven.
